card.name: Inside capitalized brand drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through an all-caps brand drug name, on the first or second piece (e.g. TEC, OL, STR, AP), before the name is finished. Seen in dosing and administration sections.

modes.label: Brand name in caps
modes.description: Early piece of an uppercase brand name such as TECENTRIQ, XOLAIR, DELSTRIGO or RHAPSIDO.

modes.label: Generic name partway
modes.description: Early piece of a lowercase generic name like amivantamab after a number and mg.

card.writes: It favors line breaks, spaces, punctuation and hyphens, so it adds what follows a name once complete rather than continuing the name.
card.plain: It fires while a brand drug name is still being spelled out, before the name ends.
